hypotheses.title: IsSameType(ty, json) in isLaxInner runs a full reverse mapping-BDD subtype check on every field access
hypotheses.issue: Every non-optional field access x.f resolves through resolveFieldBaseAccess -> laxFieldMemberType -> effectiveLaxType -> isLax -> isLaxInner, which first calls semtypes.IsSameType(ty, json). IsSameType is just IsSubtype(t1,t2) && IsSubtype(t2,t1) with no early exit. For a mapping type whose fields are all json-compatible (closed records, unions of such records), ty <: json holds, so the reverse json <: ty also runs: Diff(json, ty) builds a full mapping-BDD complement (bddDiff/bddNodeComplement/bddCreate/internBddNodeKey) plus a mappingFormulaIsEmpty check. Nothing caches it across calls (the semtype Context memo is fresh per function body), so it is recomputed for every field access in every function. Yet the answer is decidable from basic-type bits: json contains whole basic types (nil, boolean, int, float, decimal, string) that a mapping-only type does not intersect at all. Profile: IsSameType ~35% of CPU and ~30% of allocated bytes on the reproducer, GC ~21% of CPU on top.

reproducer.generator:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate /tmp/perfhunt/H1/repro.bal: many functions doing plain field accesses
(`r.fN`, `u.id`) on closed records / a union of closed records whose fields are
all json-compatible.

Every non-optional field access calls isLax(container type), which does
IsSameType(ty, json) = IsSubtype(ty, json) && IsSubtype(json, ty). Because the
record IS a subtype of json, the second check builds Diff(json, R) (a large
mapping BDD complement) for every single field access."""
import sys

NTYPES = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 16
NFUNCS = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 1500
NFIELDS = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 10
NACCESS = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 10


def ftype(f, t):
    return ("int", "string", "float", "boolean")[(f + t) % 4]


def fval(f, t, i):
    return (str(i), '"s"', "1.5", "true")[(f + t) % 4]


out = ["import ballerina/io;\n"]
for t in range(NTYPES):
    fields = "\n".join(f"    {ftype(f, t)} f{f};" for f in range(NFIELDS))
    out.append(f"type R{t} record {{|\n    int id;\n{fields}\n    int[] xs;\n    map<string> m;\n|}};\n")

out.append("type U " + "|".join(f"R{t}" for t in range(NTYPES)) + ";\n")
for i in range(NFUNCS):
    t = i % NTYPES
    int_fields = [f for f in range(NFIELDS) if ftype(f, t) == "int"]
    body = []
    for k in range(NACCESS):
        f = int_fields[k % len(int_fields)]
        body.append(f"    s += r.f{f} + u.id;")
    body.append("    s += u.xs.length();")
    out.append(f"function fn{i}(R{t} r, U u) returns int {{\n    int s = 0;\n" + "\n".join(body) + "\n    return s;\n}\n")

out.append("public function main() {\n    int total = 0;")
for t in range(NTYPES):
    lits = ", ".join(f"f{f}: {fval(f, t, 1)}" for f in range(NFIELDS))
    out.append(f"    R{t} r{t} = {{id: {t}, {lits}, xs: [1, 2], m: {{}}}};")
for i in range(NFUNCS):
    out.append(f"    total += fn{i}(r{i % NTYPES}, r{(i + 1) % NTYPES});")
out.append("    io:println(total);\n}\n")
open("/tmp/perfhunt/H1/repro.bal", "w").write("\n".join(out))

hypotheses.fix_approach: Add a cheap early exit at the top of semtypes.IsSameType: if either type has an all() (whole) value basic type bit that the other type does not touch at all (neither all nor some), return false before running either IsSubtype. Sound because Diff always keeps such a bit in the result's all bits and IsEmpty is false when all() != 0. Pitfall: mask with valueTypeMask, because Diff special-cases t2 == full value-type mask (all2 == valueTypeMask, some2 == 0) and returns Never, so a t1 carrying cell/undef bits outside valueTypeMask would otherwise be wrongly reported as not-same. Alternative/complement: hoist or cache the json check in isLaxInner (e.g. reject non-mapping/non-json quickly, or memoize per interned type). make test passes; no behaviour change.

notes: Follow-up spotted during exploration (not pursued): with is-narrowing from unions, resolveTypeTestExpr / mapping IsEmpty is recomputed per function because ContextFrom creates a fresh semtype memo for each function body.
